content.title: About
content.content: PediaSure is a specialized toddler nutritional drink formulated to support growth and development in children aged 1 to 3 years. The formula is enriched with vitamins, minerals, and proteins, providing balanced nutrition during periods of increased needs.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: PediaSure is available in several flavors, including vanilla and chocolate.
The blend contains easily digestible milk and soy proteins.
Clinical studies have demonstrated its effectiveness in supporting weight gain in children with growth deficits.
It includes DHA and ARA, essential fatty acids for brain development.
PediaSure can be used as a supplement to regular meals under a healthcare professional’s guidance.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: Balanced levels of protein, calcium, and vitamin D promote bone and muscle formation.

items.title: Boosts immunity
items.content: Vitamins A, C and zinc help maintain the body’s defensive functions.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA contribute to the development of the nervous system and cognitive abilities.

items.title: Energy provision
items.content: Easily digestible carbohydrates provide a quick source of energy.

items.title: Improves nutritional status
items.content: Micronutrients such as iron and folic acid help prevent deficiency conditions.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The product contains milk protein; consult a physician if an allergy is known.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Added sugars are present, so intake should be limited for children at risk of dental caries.

items.title: Not a meal replacement
items.content: PediaSure is intended only as a supplement to a varied diet, not as a complete substitute.

items.title: Caloric excess
items.content: Overconsumption may lead to unwanted weight gain if total daily calories are not accounted for.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix 1 packet (≈30 g) with 200 ml of warm (not hot) water or milk. Recommended intake is 1–2 servings per day between meals, following pediatric guidance.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened packages in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 30 days and keep refrigerated.
